change: Added Trend_Purity to VOL_PHASE_MULTS with EXTREME multiplier 0.3

rationale: Stale block based on 3 trades with 0%WR. Current 7d data: 20 trades, 65%WR, +$1.01 in HIGH. Multiplier clamped to 0.3 still allowed trades — raising to 0.7 captures more of the edge.
impact: +$0.50-1.00/7d expected

change: Fixed VOL_PHASE_MULTS key mismatch — Pullback_Entry_Short→Pullback_Entry (NORMAL 0.0, HIGH 0.7), R2→R2_Structural (NORMAL 0.5)
before: Keys Pullback_Entry_Short and R2 never matched signal_family() output. Multipliers silently ignored (always 1.0).
after: Keys corrected to Pullback_Entry and R2_Structural. NORMAL blocks pullback-entry (0.0), penalizes rr-struct (0.5). HIGH relaxes pullback-entry (0.7), blocks rr-struct (0.0).
rationale: Bug fix — multipliers were never applied. Pullback-entry SHORT in NORMAL: 15T 53.3%WR -$0.01. rr-struct SHORT in HIGH: 4T 25%WR -$0.41. Key mismatch prevented regime-specific filtering.
impact: ~$0.18/7d from blocked NORMAL pullback-entry trades + reduced HIGH false positives. Net slightly positive.

after: SHORT_NORMAL_PENALTY=0.85 (15% confidence penalty for SHORT in NORMAL)
rationale: SHORT in NORMAL 30T/7d 44%WR -$0.79 — worst regime+direction combo. EXTREME 81.8%WR +$1.74, HIGH 62.5%WR +$1.04.
impact: +$0.20-0.30/7d expected from reduced false SHORT entries in flat markets

change: SHORT_RSI_CEILING=65 added — block SHORT entries when RSI > 65 (overbought)

rationale: 20T/7d SHORT RSI>=65 50%WR -$1.02. Overbought SHORT = momentum continuation risk. Only 1 active-signal winner killed (LTC +$0.02 tiny).

after: Skip signal if is_stale=True from token_speeds DB

change: ATR_SL_MIN 1.2%→1.3% (+ all matched deps: ATR_SL_MIN_INIT, SL_PCT_FALLBACK, TP_PCT_FALLBACK 3.6%→3.9%, STOP_LOSS_DEFAULT, SL_PCT_MIN)

before: No BB position filter for SHORT

rationale: BB 0.35-0.55 zone: 25T 44%WR -$0.99/7d across all SHORT signals. Chop zone, no edge.

change: Created standalone feature_recorder.py and updated brain.py import to fix feature recording
before: brain.py imported record_entry_features from hl_sync_guardian — module-level lock caused sys.exit(1) when guardian running, features never recorded
after: brain.py imports from feature_recorder.py — standalone module, no lock dependency. 5 open trades retroactively recorded.
rationale: All 278 trades in 14 days had features_recorded=FALSE. Root cause: hl-sync-guardian.py module-level lock acquisition prevents import from brain.py. feature_recorder.py extracts just the needed functions.
impact: All future trades will have entry_rsi_14, entry_bb_position, entry_macd_hist, entry_atr_14 recorded. Enables entry-condition analysis after 48h.

change: DISABLED trend_ignition (TREND_IGNITION_ENABLED=False, TREND_IGNITION_PLUS_ENABLED=False)
rationale: 0 trades in 3+ days. Dead signal. LONG-only, 7 conditions impossible in NEUTRAL market.
impact: Zero — no trades to lose

change: NO CONFIG CHANGE — 2 code bugs confirmed (RSI mismatch, exit_conditions blank), 3 creative ideas generated
rationale: System structurally healthy. All findings are code-level fixes, not config changes.
impact: Identified ~$3.85/7d lost from stale signals, RSI filter bypass, and blind exit analysis

change: Align SHORT_RSI_CEILING filter from candles_5m to candles_1m
before: candles_5m (5m resolution RSI used for ceiling check)
after: candles_1m (1m resolution RSI used for ceiling check)
rationale: ETC SHORT entered RSI=70.14 (>65 ceiling) but passed filter because 5m RSI was 40.0. Filter mismatch allowed overbought SHORT entry.
impact: Blocks SHORT entries when 1m RSI > 65. ETC SHORT would have been blocked (-$0.28 saved). No winning SHORT in 7d had RSI > 65.

change: exit_conditions recording fix — brain.py close_trade() now accepts exit_conditions param, adds to UPDATE statement, CLI parser supports --exit-conditions
before: exit_conditions column existed but was never populated (99.96% blank). UPDATE statement at line 910 did not include exit_conditions.
after: close_trade() accepts exit_conditions param (default None), _close_trade_impl() accepts it, UPDATE sets exit_conditions = COALESCE(%s, exit_conditions), CLI parser has --exit-conditions argument.
rationale: Exit analysis impossible without exit_conditions data. Column existed but was never written to. Now callers can pass exit conditions for data quality.
impact: Exit analysis becomes possible. No behavior change for existing callers (exit_conditions defaults to None).

change: RSI timeframe fix — SHORT_RSI_CEILING now uses 1m candles (candles_5m → candles_1m)
before: candles_5m (5m RSI data, let ETC SHORT RSI=70.14 through)
rationale: Filter was using 5m RSI but entry_rsi_14 stores 1m RSI. ETC SHORT entered RSI=70.14 (>65 ceiling) but passed 5m filter. With 1m data, would have been blocked.
impact: Blocks overbought SHORT entries that previously slipped through. ETC-type trades prevented.

change: Added token_speeds.is_stale check to pullback_entry.py scan_signals() — blocks stale tokens from generating pullback_entry signals
rationale: 41 stale pullback-entry- SHORT 7d = -$0.27 vs 37 fresh = +$1.00. Stale tokens have no momentum — pullback entries in flat markets fail. Other signals (trend_purity, r2_trend) already block stale.
